en: Made up of many connected parts and hard to understand; or a group of buildings; or a mental problem.
ex: The rules of the game are too complex for young children.
這個遊戲的規則對年幼的孩子來說太複雜了。

en: A feeling of worry about something; or something important to you; or to involve or affect someone.
ex: Parents show great concern for their children's health.
父母十分關心孩子的健康。

en: To decide that something is true after thinking about the facts; or to end something.
ex: The police concluded that the fire was an accident.
警方斷定那場火災是意外。

en: The state of something; or something that must happen before something else can; or the health of a person.
ex: The car is old but still in good condition.
這輛車很舊，但狀況還很好。

en: Feeling sure that you can do something well; or certain that something is true.
ex: She felt confident about passing the exam.
她對通過考試很有信心。

en: A relationship between two things; or a train or plane that you catch after another; or a link to the internet.
ex: There is no connection between the two events.
這兩件事之間沒有關聯。

en: To think carefully about something; or to believe that someone or something is a particular thing.
ex: She is considering moving to a new city.
她正在考慮搬到一座新城市。

en: The act of thinking carefully about something; or a fact that you think about before deciding; or kind thought for others.
ex: Please take cost into consideration before you buy.
購買前請考慮費用。

en: The state of communicating with someone; or to get in touch with someone; or touch between two things.
ex: Please contact me if you have any questions.
如果你有任何問題，請與我聯絡。

en: A talk between two or more people.
ex: We had a long conversation about our plans for the summer.
我們針對暑假計畫聊了很久。

en: A tall plant with large yellow seeds that is grown as food; or a small, hard area of skin on the foot.
ex: The farmers grow corn and wheat on their land.
農夫在他們的土地上種玉米和小麥。

en: Land outside cities and towns, with fields, farms and villages.
ex: We spent the weekend in the quiet countryside.
我們在安靜的鄉間度過了週末。

en: Two people who are married or in a relationship; or two things of the same kind; or a few.
ex: The couple have been married for twenty years.
這對夫婦已經結婚二十年了。

en: A man who looks after cattle on a ranch in the western United States.
ex: The cowboy rode his horse across the wide plains.
牛仔騎著馬穿越寬廣的平原。

en: A stick of colored wax used for drawing, especially by children.
ex: The child drew a house with a red crayon.
那個孩子用紅色蠟筆畫了一棟房子。

en: The thick, yellow-white liquid from milk used in cooking or on desserts; or a soft substance put on the skin.
ex: She put some cream in her coffee.
她在咖啡裡加了一些奶精。

en: To make something new exist; or to cause something to happen; or to produce a work of art.
ex: The artist created a beautiful painting of the sea.
那位藝術家創作了一幅美麗的海景畫。

en: An illegal act that can be punished by law; or illegal activities in general.
ex: The police are investigating the crime.
警方正在調查這起案件。

en: A time of great danger, difficulty or trouble; or a time when an important decision must be made.
ex: The country is facing a serious economic crisis.
這個國家正面臨嚴重的經濟危機。

en: A large, black bird with a loud cry; or the loud cry of a rooster; or to brag about something.
ex: A crow was sitting on the fence and cawing loudly.
一隻烏鴉坐在籬笆上大聲鳴叫。

en: A large number of people gathered in one place; or to fill a place so that it is uncomfortably full.
ex: A large crowd gathered outside the stadium.
一大群人聚集在體育場外。

en: Relating to the culture of a society; or connected with the arts, ideas and customs of a group.
ex: The festival is an important cultural event in the city.
這個節慶是這座城市重要的文化活動。

en: The arts, ideas and customs of a society; or the way of life of a particular group.
ex: She is interested in the culture and history of Japan.
她對日本的文化和歷史很感興趣。

en: Eager to learn or know something; or strange and unusual.
ex: The child was curious about everything around him.
那個孩子對周圍的一切都很好奇。

en: Happening or existing now; or a flow of water, air or electricity in one direction.
ex: What is your current address?
你現在的地址是什麼？

en: A traditional way of behaving in a particular group; or something that you do regularly; or (plural) the place where goods enter a country.
ex: It is the custom to take off your shoes before entering a Japanese house.
進日本人的家前脫鞋是種習俗。

en: A person who buys goods or services from a shop or company.
ex: The shop assistant helped the customer find a gift.
店員幫顧客挑選禮物。

en: A series of events that repeat in the same order; or a bicycle; or to ride a bicycle.
ex: He cycles to work every day to keep fit.
他每天騎腳踏車上班來保持健康。

en: Happening or done every day; or a newspaper published every day.
ex: Reading the news is part of his daily routine.
讀新聞是他日常生活的一部分。

en: A person who dances, especially as a job.
ex: The dancer performed on stage for thousands of people.
那位舞者在舞台上為數千人表演。

en: The possibility that someone may be harmed or killed; or something that may cause harm.
ex: The firefighters rescued the children from danger.
消防員從危險中救出了孩子們。

en: Unable to hear, or only able to hear a little.
ex: My grandfather is deaf and uses a hearing aid.
我祖父耳聾，戴著助聽器。

en: Money that you owe to someone; or the state of owing money.
ex: He worked hard to pay off all his debts.
他努力工作還清了所有債務。

en: A choice that you make after thinking about something; or the act of making up your mind.
ex: It was a difficult decision to leave her hometown.
離開家鄉是個艱難的決定。

en: A large, wild animal with long legs; the male has large branching horns called antlers.
ex: We saw a deer drinking from the stream.
我們看見一隻鹿在溪邊喝水。

en: A unit for measuring temperature or angles; or a level or amount of something; or a university qualification.
ex: The temperature fell to ten degrees below zero.
氣溫降到零下十度。

en: To make something happen later than planned; or a period of time when something is late.
ex: The train was delayed for an hour because of the snow.
火車因下雪延誤了一小時。

en: Having a very pleasant taste or smell.
ex: The soup smells delicious.
這碗湯聞起來好香。

en: To take goods or letters to a place; or to make a speech; or to help a baby be born.
ex: The postman delivers letters to our house every morning.
郵差每天早上送信到我們家。

en: The act of taking goods or letters to a place; or the birth of a baby; or the way a person gives a speech.
ex: The delivery of the package takes two days.
包裹的寄送要兩天。
